package main

import (
	"fmt"
	"os"
	"os/exec"
	"strconv"
	"time"
)

func main() {
	code := 0
	if len(os.Args) > 1 && os.Args[1] == "interrupt" {
		code = interruptSetup()
	} else {
		code = runGo()
	}
	os.Exit(code)
}

func runGo() int {
	cmd := exec.Command(os.Getenv("GOLAW_M2_REAL_GO"), os.Args[1:]...)
	cmd.Env = os.Environ()
	cmd.Stdin, cmd.Stdout, cmd.Stderr = os.Stdin, os.Stdout, os.Stderr
	if err := cmd.Run(); err != nil {
		return 1
	}
	if len(os.Args) < 2 || os.Args[1] != "install" {
		return 0
	}
	marker := os.Getenv("GOLAW_M2_MARKER")
	if err := os.WriteFile(marker, []byte(strconv.Itoa(os.Getpid())), 0o600); err != nil {
		return 2
	}
	if !waitFor(marker+".release", 30*time.Second) {
		return 3
	}
	if err := os.WriteFile(marker+".done", []byte("done\n"), 0o600); err != nil {
		return 2
	}
	return 0
}

func interruptSetup() int {
	cmd := exec.Command(os.Getenv("GOLAW_M2_BINARY"), "setup")
	cmd.Env = os.Environ()
	cmd.Stdin, cmd.Stdout, cmd.Stderr = os.Stdin, os.Stdout, os.Stderr
	if err := cmd.Start(); err != nil {
		return 4
	}
	marker := os.Getenv("GOLAW_M2_MARKER")
	reached := waitFor(marker, 18*time.Minute)
	killErr := cmd.Process.Kill()
	waitErr := cmd.Wait()
	if !reached || killErr != nil || waitErr == nil {
		return 5
	}
	if err := os.WriteFile(marker+".release", []byte("release\n"), 0o600); err != nil {
		return 6
	}
	if !waitFor(marker+".done", 30*time.Second) {
		return 7
	}
	fmt.Println("M2_INSTALL_INTERRUPTED")
	return 0
}

func waitFor(path string, limit time.Duration) bool {
	deadline := time.Now().Add(limit)
	for time.Now().Before(deadline) {
		_, err := os.Stat(path)
		if err == nil {
			return true
		}
		if !os.IsNotExist(err) {
			return false
		}
		time.Sleep(50 * time.Millisecond)
	}
	return false
}
